correctness.rationale: For the oriented cycle vector c, UU^T=P=I-cc^T/ell. For a sole collision of e,f with sign product tau, set x=U^T e_e and y=U^T e_f. The Gram perturbation is tau(xy^T+yx^T), with two eigenvalues tau<x,y> +/- ||x||||y|| and n-3 zeros; x,y are independent since c has at least three nonzero coordinates. Here <x,y>=-c_e c_f/ell and ||x||^2=1-c_e^2/ell. This gives all four stated spectra, including both sign relations. For subunit tolerance only the collision-free and mixed cycle–bridge cases pass, the latter including equality at sqrt(1-1/ell). At most n-2 occupied buckets forces a nontrivial sketch kernel on the incidence hyperplane. The falling-factorial counts then apply also for m<n and ell=n. Taking square roots of the Gram ratios gives the stated reversal of singular-value condition numbers. A separate exact-rational program checked 20 pair/sign cases on a triangle with two bridges; its print banner incorrectly says 22, but its explicit class counts are 3+3+12+2. The same program counted 288 subunit successes at tolerance 9/10 and 432 rank successes among the 1296 configurations on a triangle with one pendant edge; that count uses the proved collision classes, not an independent solver for all Gram spectra.
residual_risks: The source checker tests both sign products in one orientation pattern per cycle length, not an exhaustive range of orientations. The proof works for arbitrary orientations and deleted columns. No claim for tolerances at or above one or for weighted edge scales.

value.rationale: Exact preservation of metric information is an independent question once algebraic success is known. This gives the precise probability step and a structural example where minimizing squared-norm distortion chooses the worse-conditioned full-rank sketch. It separates metrics used for different numerical objectives on the same elementary graph and sketch, not just two definitions or a rank recount.
residual_risks: The comparison applies to orthonormalized incidence spaces and actual collision patterns when m>=n-1, not to raw incidence conditioning or a claim about runtime.
